nonce.description: Optional opaque value the requester may supply to correlate the response to this probe. The mediator echoes it verbatim in the response.

Response.title: Messaging Ping — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/ping request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/ping/0.1#response.

serverTime.description: The mediator's current time (RFC 3339). Advisory; not a trusted time source.

status.description: Coarse health. `ok` = able to accept and route messages; `degraded` = reachable but operating with reduced function. A mediator that cannot serve at all returns the framework `unavailable` error instead of a response.

protocols.description: The transport protocols the mediator currently serves (e.g. `didcomm`, `tsp`). Open set; requesters ignore unrecognized tokens. MAY be omitted in a reduced response to an unauthenticated requester.

nonce.description: Echoed verbatim from the request when one was supplied.
